title: Deleted component Dialog
context: The cart page no longer asks a shopper to confirm before the cart empties. One click on the button now removes every item, and no step lets the shopper keep them. The dialog that asked the question had no other use, so the shared components no longer have a dialog.
- **When** a shopper clicks "Empty the cart" on the cart page, **then** [the cart empties on that click](code:src/routes/cart/components/CartSummary.tsx#L12), and no "Empty the cart?" dialog opens.
- **When** the cart is empty after that click, **then** nothing changes: the cart page shows "Your cart is empty."
- **When** a shopper uses a button or an input on another page, **then** nothing changes.
- Deleted `src/components/ui/dialog.tsx`, which held the component `Dialog` and its type `DialogProps`.
- Removed the export of `Dialog` from the barrel, which [now exports `Button` and `Input` only](code:src/components/ui/index.ts#L1-2).
- Removed the import of `useState`, and modified [the import from `@/components/ui` to take `Button` only](code:src/routes/cart/components/CartSummary.tsx#L1).
- Removed the state `isConfirming`, the function `handleConfirm()` and the `<Dialog>` element from [`<CartSummary />`](code:src/routes/cart/components/CartSummary.tsx#CartSummary).
- Modified [the `onClick` of the "Empty the cart" button to run `clear`](code:src/routes/cart/components/CartSummary.tsx#L12), in place of `() => setIsConfirming(true)`.
diff: -export function Dialog({ title, open, onClose, children }: DialogProps) {
-      <Dialog title="Empty the cart?" open={isConfirming} onClose={() => setIsConfirming(false)}>

waypoints.title: Removed the export of `Dialog`
waypoints.reading: The author removed an export, `Dialog`, from the barrel of the shared components, which now exports `Button` and `Input` only. `src/components/ui/dialog.tsx` is deleted in the same change, so the export had no file left to read from. [`<CartSummary />` was the one file that imported `Dialog`](code:src/routes/cart/components/CartSummary.tsx#L1), and its import now takes `Button` only, so that no file asks the barrel for the removed name.

waypoints.title: Removed the imports the dialog needed
waypoints.reading: The author removed two imports, `useState` from `react` and `Dialog` from `@/components/ui`, and the import from `@/components/ui` now takes `Button` only. [`<CartSummary />` no longer declares the state `isConfirming` and no longer renders `<Dialog>`](code:src/routes/cart/components/CartSummary.tsx#CartSummary), so nothing in the file reads either name. [The barrel no longer exports `Dialog`](code:src/components/ui/index.ts#L1-2), so the old import would name an export that does not exist.

waypoints.title: Removed the confirmation step from `<CartSummary />`
waypoints.reading:
The author modified a component, `<CartSummary />`, that now:

- runs `clear` when a shopper clicks "Empty the cart", where the `onClick` ran `() => setIsConfirming(true)` before
- declares no state and no handler of its own: `isConfirming` and `handleConfirm()` are removed
- renders no `<Dialog>`, so the title "Empty the cart?" and the "Empty it" button are removed with it

[`clear` sets `items` to `[]`](code:src/stores/cart-store.ts#L19-21), so that one click empties the cart and [`<CartPage />` then returns "Your cart is empty."](code:src/routes/cart/index.tsx#L7). `<Button>` passes `onClick` to its `<button>`, so `clear` now receives the click event, and [`clear` reads no argument](code:src/stores/cart-store.ts#L19-21).
waypoints.needsAttention: This is the change the pull request exists for: one click on "Empty the cart" now runs [`clear`](code:src/stores/cart-store.ts#L19-21), and no step asks the shopper first. The other waypoints remove what the dialog needed.
